conversion_chain.convention_status: UNVERIFIED — assumed for the dry run, must be resolved verbatim from the source

assumed_convention.reference_length_l_ref: L (ship length) OR delta* (boundary-layer scale) — the source must state which; CHK7 quantifies the difference

steps.note: dynamic pressure; kg/m^3 * (m/s)^2 = kg m^-1 s^-2 = Pa
Pa^2 * (m / (m/s)) = Pa^2 s; the bracket (l_ref/V) carries s
2*pi is dimensionless; spectral density per Hz equals per rad/s up to 2*pi

conversion_chain.closure_identity: INT S_p domega = q^2 * Cp_rms^2 = p_rms^2

machine_checks.method: exponent algebra over (kg, m, s) for both sides of every conversion step

steps.note: dynamic pressure; kg/m^3 * (m/s)^2 = kg m^-1 s^-2 = Pa
Pa^2 * (m / (m/s)) = Pa^2 s; the bracket (l_ref/V) carries s
2*pi is dimensionless; spectral density per Hz equals per rad/s up to 2*pi

machine_checks.method: apply S1..S3 forward on a reduced-frequency band (0.2..9, 4001 points), then invert both the ordinate and the abscissa and compare
machine_checks.fixture_note: evaluated on the synthetic dry-run fixture, not on a source anchor

machine_checks.method: trapezoidal quadrature of the nondimensional spectrum vs its closed-form moment; then quadrature of the dimensionalised spectrum vs (q*Cp_rms)^2
evaluate S_p(f) in (kg, m, s) and in (kg, cm, s); map the cm result back with 1 kg/(cm s^2) = 100 Pa and compare
S_p(rho, V, L, f) rescaled by lambda at fixed reduced frequency (L/V is invariant under a common scaling of L and V, so f is held); compares against the analytic exponents rho^2 V^3 L^1

(a) multi-sine synthesis on orthogonal bins -> record variance vs spectral variance; (b) 16 random-phase realisations, record variance averaged over seeds (declared tolerance 3%, expected standard error ~1.1%)
map an identical reduced-frequency band onto the case frequency axis under the two candidate reference lengths
machine_checks.quantifies: the frequency-axis ambiguity produced by an unresolved nondimensionalisation convention
machine_checks.decision_use: supports WITHHELD on the anchor transfer: the convention must be resolved verbatim first

what_would_close_it: operator supplies an authorised copy (or licensed access) of SNAME T&R Bulletin 3-37 (1997) and 4-7
two independent transcribers fill entries[] with quote + table/page + printed values as strings
resolve the nondimensionalisation block (pressure scale, frequency scale, reference length) verbatim
re-run this script: C1 flips to PASS, the transfer executes on the real anchor, and only then may the anchor be compared with the domain result

limitations: The dry-run fixture coefficients are arbitrary; the numbers under dry_run_fixture carry no physical meaning and must not be quoted.

The convention block (pressure scale / frequency scale / reference length) is assumed, not sourced; CHK7 shows the frequency axis moves by L/delta* ~ 320 when the reference length changes between the hull length and the boundary-layer scale, so an assumed convention is not good enough for a transfer.
Dimensional homogeneity and moment closure validate the arithmetic of the chain only; they say nothing about agreement with the external anchor.
delta* = 1.0 m and V = 7.9732 m/s are declared case inputs, not measured values of a specific ship.
